title: Vampy Girl Of Big-Foot de Thalek

parts: Vampy Girl Of Big-Foot de Thalek
Female born on July 7, 2000. HD: B-A. Shoulder height: 59 cm.
Parents DNA-identified at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine in León.
From the cross of our female Wanda and Multi Ch. Impact Performance, a male from Brinkley lines and very old lines such as Pockethall.
She has a very feminine outline, with an excellent head, dark brown eyes with excellent pigmentation and good angulation. Her movement is very typical and harmonious.
So far, Vampy has appeared in the ring in puppy and open classes, achieving very good results. She now enjoys a quiet life in retirement.
Her mother's bearing and elegance of movement, great intelligence and ability to learn are evident in her.
